label: Round Photo Lithophane
description: Classic circular backlit photo plate. Builds in seconds.

frame_width.label: Frame width
frame_width.help: Solid border around the photo. Also what you hold, so don't go below ~3 mm.

min_thickness.label: Thinnest layer
min_thickness.help: Where the photo is brightest. Thinner = brighter, but below ~0.8 mm it gets fragile.

max_thickness.label: Thickest layer
max_thickness.help: Where the photo is darkest. Thicker = more contrast, but slower to print.

base_height.label: Base thickness
base_height.help: Solid backing behind the image. Keep at least 1 mm so the print is strong.
